name: How do I choose the right contractor for a distressed property renovation?

mainEntity.name: How do I choose the right contractor for a distressed property renovation?

acceptedAnswer.text: Choose a contractor with verifiable hands-on experience in whole-scope interior remodeling, structural framing repairs, and finish carpentry. Foreclosed homes present unpredictable challenges behind closed walls, so you need a professional who actively leads on-site work rather than a desk-bound broker who hands off tasks to unknown crews. Check that the business carries proper licensing, general liability insurance, and an established track record, such as BBB accreditation. Asking candidates how they handle unexpected issues—like hidden water leaks, degraded subfloors, or coordinating electrical and plumbing sub-trades—will reveal their practical field problem-solving skills.
acceptedAnswer.description: Look for an insured, hands-on general contractor experienced in structural framing and interior finishes who personally oversees the jobsite and coordinates trades.
